title: Files on Azure Blob Storage: source

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the files are: azblob://container/prefix. Each stream's glob is relative to it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The blob service's URL, for one other than https://ACCOUNT.blob.core.windows.net, such as Azurite's http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1.

accountName.title: Account name
accountName.description: The storage account. Needed with accountKey, sasToken or Azure's default credentials, unless the endpoint names it.

accountKey.title: Account key
accountKey.description: The account's shared key. Set at most one of accountKey, sasToken and connectionString; without any, Azure's default credentials.

sasToken.title: SAS token
sasToken.description: A shared access signature for the container, the query string it is.

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: The account's connection string, which names the account and its key or a SAS.

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: The streams, each the files a glob matches, of one format.

glob.description: The files' keys, relative to the URL: * and ? match within a path segment, ** any number of segments, {a,b} either alternative, and [...] a character. The part before the first of them is the prefix the source lists, so start the glob with a fixed directory where you can.
glob.title: Glob

format.description: The files' format: Parquet, Avro object container files, CSV or JSON Lines. A file ending .gz, .gzip, .zst, .zstd, .sz or .snappy is decompressed with gzip, zstd or framed snappy first; Parquet's and Avro's own compression needs nothing.
format.title: Format

csv.description: CSV: how the files are written.

delimiter.description: The character between fields, such as a tab.
delimiter.title: Delimiter

quote.description: The character fields are quoted with; doubled inside one, it is the character itself.
quote.title: Quote

header.description: Whether each file's first line, after skipRows, names its columns.
header.title: Header

columnNames.description: The columns of files without a header, in order. Without them, f0, f1 and so on.
columnNames.title: Column names

skipRows.description: Lines to skip at the start of each file, before the header.
skipRows.title: Rows to skip

encoding.description: The files' character encoding, as a WHATWG label such as windows-1252 or utf-16le.
encoding.title: Encoding

nullValues.description: Unquoted values that are null. A quoted value never is: "" is an empty string.
nullValues.title: Null values

csv.title: CSV

columns.description: Columns' types, by name, over the ones discovery finds: string, integer, number, boolean, date, time, timestamp (without a time zone), timestamp_tz, json, binary or decimal(P,S). A column of CSV or JSON Lines that discovery's sample doesn't show must be named here. A Parquet or Avro column named here is sent as text, which OpenETL parses to the type, quarantining a value that doesn't fit.
columns.title: Column types

primaryKey.description: The stream's key. Without one, _file and _line: the file and the record's number in it.
primaryKey.title: Primary key

lookback.title: Lookback
lookback.description: Incremental reads: how long before the newest file read the next read still looks for files it hasn't read, as a duration such as 1h or 30m. A file that appears dated more than that before the newest file read is missed.

x-groups.title: Location
x-groups.description: Where the files are, and the address of the store's API.

x-groups.title: Streams
x-groups.description: The files each stream reads, and how.
